description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface to filter log messages by only forwarding message content. It is used for simplified on-screen logging output in an Android application.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode filter that forwards only the message part of logs, omitting metadata like tags and priorities to simplify log output.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor - initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Default constructor - creates a filter with no subsequent LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters log messages, forwarding only the message content to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to forward messages to.
